entry.title: Blackout Survival 1 Year: 90 Days In The Dark After The Grid Died | Ep.3

media:group.media:title: Blackout Survival 1 Year: 90 Days In The Dark After The Grid Died | Ep.3
media:group.media:description:
Sixty days since the grid died. Four armed men walk the railway tracks above you, and their torch beam just stopped on your footprints in the snow. To survive Month 3, you have to vanish underground and uncover the dark truth about why the entire town's food disappeared.
Welcome to Episode 3 (Days 61–90) of BLACKOUT SURVIVAL 1 YEAR. After escaping the railway hut through a frozen storm drain, Skilly and ER nurse Maya take shelter inside an abandoned Municipal Seed Depot greenhouse in -14°C winter. From building a lightless clay pot paraffin heater and spotting poisoned pink-dyed grain, to saving a frostbitten retired signalman named Arthur who holds the map to 40,000 stolen council ration tins every decision comes with a cost.
Every survival rule in this episode is based on real-world cold weather physiology, off-grid heating, and emergency food safety: • Blackout Rule 1 Applied (Day 61): Why wet boots in January trigger frostbite in 30 minutes • Blackout Rule 3 Applied (Day 64): Heating a glass greenhouse with terracotta clay pots & paraffin without glowing at night • Blackout Rule 12 (Day 69): Never eat agricultural seed coated in pink or blue fungicide dye • Frostbite First Aid (Day 75): Why rubbing frozen hands destroys tissue and thawing in 40°C warm water instead • The Reveal (Day 82): Where the armed Committee's Sunday diesel lorries are actually taking the town's food
⏱️ CHAPTERS / TIMESTAMPS: 0:00 Day 60–61: The 6 Minute Clock & Storm Sewer Escape 0:31 Day 61: The Tunnel Water Trap & Municipal Seed Depot 2:17 Day 64: Heating a Glass Greenhouse Without Light (Clay Pot Trick) 3:21 Day 69: The Pink Seed Poison Trap & Hand Milling Wheat (Rule 12) 4:36 Day 75: Roof Meltwater & The Old Man at the Gate (Arthur) 6:53 Day 82: Look at the Old Numbers Again (Where the Food Went) 7:43 Day 86: Minus 14°C & The Greenhouse Roof Collapse 8:42 Day 90: The Red Armband on the Gate (Cliffhanger)

entry.title: Blackout Survival 1 Year: 60 Days In a Frozen Dead City | Ep.2

media:group.media:title: Blackout Survival 1 Year: 60 Days In a Frozen Dead City | Ep.2
media:group.media:description:
The steel head of a sledgehammer punches straight through your front door lock. Outside on the third floor landing, twelve armed men from the Neighbourhood Recovery Committee are waiting to take everything you own. Fighting them in a narrow hallway gets you killed in ten seconds.
Welcome to Episode 2 (Days 31–60) of BLACKOUT SURVIVAL 1 YEAR. After surviving the first 30 days inside your third-floor flat, your shelter is breached on Night 30. Follow Skilly and ER nurse Maya as they escape down a knotted rescue line into a frozen dead city with only 8 litres of water and 9 tins of food and fight to survive Month 2 in an abandoned railway signalman's hut.
Every survival rule in this episode is based on real world urban evacuation, cold weather physiology, and off grid field medicine: • Rule 7 (Day 31): Figure eight follow through knots vs. square knots & padding sharp masonry window edges • Rule 8 (Day 33): The 10 to 1 snow to water ratio & why eating raw snow triggers lethal hypothermia (latent heat of fusion) • Rule 9 (Day 36): Foraging non obvious calories in upper floor office break rooms skipped by ground floor looters • Smoke Discipline (Day 40): Scavenging dry seasoned hardwood pallets at the 4:00 AM circadian low • Rule 10 (Day 44): High pressure pinhole bottle wound irrigation & why you never suture a dirty puncture wound shut • Rule 11 (Day 51): Building a 3 stage bottle bio filter (pebbles, sand, and crushed stove charcoal) to purify cloudy culvert water before bleaching
⏱️ CHAPTERS / TIMESTAMPS: 0:00 Day 31: The Sledgehammer Breach & Third-Floor Rope Escape (Rule 7) 1:22 Day 33: Into the Frozen City & Why Raw Snow Kills You (Rule 8) 2:27 Day 36: The Railway Hut & 4th-Floor Office Vending Machine Haul (Rule 9) 3:31 Day 40: Out of Gas & The 4:00 AM Firewood Run (Smoke Discipline) 4:20 Day 44: The Rusted Pallet Nail Injury & Field Wound Irrigation (Rule 10) 5:16 Day 48: The Allotment Borehole Blockade (1 Tin Per 5 Litres) 6:02 Day 51: The Downhill Culvert & 3-Stage Charcoal Bio-Filter (Rule 11) 7:05 Day 55: The 3-Day Blizzard & The Cracked Jerrycan Disaster 7:48 Day 60: Footprints in the Snow (The Railway Embankment Cliffhanger)

entry.title: Blackout Survival 1 Year: 30 Days In Total Darkness | Ep.1

media:group.media:title: Blackout Survival 1 Year: 30 Days In Total Darkness | Ep.1
media:group.media:description:
The kettle clicks off early. The streetlamps die. Your mobile signal drops to a hollow circle. Most people wait for the power to come back and that single mistake costs them everything by week two.
Welcome to Episode 1 (Days 1–30) of BLACKOUT, a 1 year survival series tracking 365 days in a total national grid collapse. Follow Skilly from the first ten minutes of the blackout capturing 160 litres of mains water before gravity pressure fails through freezing indoor temperatures, lethal carbon monoxide traps, water purification, and nighttime stairwell looters, right up to the Day 30 cliffhanger.
Every survival rule in this video is based on real world emergency preparedness and urban grid down science: • Rule 1: Harvesting gravity fed water & locking the main stopcock against back siphonage • Rule 2: Fridge/freezer thermal timelines & salt curing thawing meat over low flame • Rule 3: Light and scent discipline in a dark city • Rule 4: Micro-shelter heating (tent on-mattress thermal trapping) • Rule 5: Carbon monoxide survival & cross-draught ventilation • Rule 6: Twin-bucket sanitation & household bleach water purification (5% sodium hypochlorite)
